## Maths

Inline: $\zeta(s) = \sum_{n \ge 1} n^{-s}$. Display, numbered so you can refer to it as @eq-gauss:

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} \dd x = \sqrt{\pi}
$$ {#eq-gauss}

Hover any display equation to get a **Copy TeX** button. Site-wide macros (defined in `theme/katex-macros.html`) include `\N \Z \Q \R \C \F`, `\abs{x}`, `\norm{v}`, `\floor{x}`, `\set{\dots}`, `\inner{u}{v}`, `\dd`:
$$
\abs{x} \le \norm{v}, \qquad \floor{\pi} = 3, \qquad \set{n \in \Z : n > 0} = \N.
$$

Aligned equations:
$$
\begin{aligned}
(a+b)^2 &= a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \\
        &\ge 4ab.
\end{aligned}
$$

## Theorem-like environments

Each type gets its own counter, and any of them can be cross-referenced: @thm-demo, @lem-demo, @def-demo.

::: {#thm-demo}
## Optional name
Theorems, lemmas (`#lem-`), corollaries (`#cor-`), propositions (`#prp-`), and conjectures (`#cnj-`) are set in italics with a marigold rule.
:::

::: {#lem-demo}
A lemma.
:::

::: {#def-demo}
## Definition style
Definitions (`#def-`), examples (`#exm-`), and exercises (`#exr-`) are set upright.
:::

::: {#cnj-demo}
Conjectures get a dashed rule.
:::

::: {.proof}
Proofs end with a filled square.
:::

::: {.remark}
Remarks are quieter.
:::

## Callouts

::: {.callout-note}
## Note
Use `callout-note`, `callout-tip`, `callout-warning`, `callout-important`, `callout-caution`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## A collapsible hint (click me)
Add `collapse="true"` to hide a hint or a spoiler until the reader asks for it.
:::

## Sidenotes and margin content

Footnotes become sidenotes on wide screens.^[Like this one. On phones they appear at the bottom.] You can also put anything in the margin:

::: {.column-margin}
A margin note, written with `::: {.column-margin}`. Figures can go here too.
:::

## Code

```python
def sieve(n):
    is_prime = [True] * (n + 1)
    is_prime[0:2] = [False, False]
    for p in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1):
        if is_prime[p]:
            is_prime[p*p::p] = [False] * len(is_prime[p*p::p])
    return [p for p, ok in enumerate(is_prime) if ok]
```

## Interactive widgets (Observable JS, no install needed)

```{ojs}
//| echo: true
viewof k = Inputs.range([1, 20], {value: 6, step: 1, label: "k"})
md`$${k}! = ${d3.range(1, k + 1).reduce((a, b) => a * b, 1).toLocaleString()}$`
```

## Images, tables, quotes

Images in the post folder can be placed with `![Caption](image.png)` and are zoomable on click.

| $n$ | $n!$ | $n^n$ |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 5 | 120 | 3125 |
| 10 | 3628800 | 10000000000 |

## Wide content

::: {.column-page}
Use `.column-page` or `.column-screen` for something that needs room, like a big diagram or a wide table.
:::
